SPECIAL WEATHER OUTLOOK ON LABOR DAY 2026
(01 May 2026)

The Easterlies will be the dominant weather system to affect the country on Labor Day.

It will bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Zamboanga Peninsula, Northern Mindanao, Caraga, Davao Region, Palawan, Southern Leyte, and Basilan. Meanwhile, partly cloudy to cloudy skies will be experienced over Metro Manila and the rest of the country, with the possibility of isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms.

Light to moderate easterly to northeasterly winds will prevail over the whole archipelago, with slight to moderate seas.

Warm and humid conditions will persist in most parts of the country. To avoid fatigue, heat cramps, and heat exhaustion: 

✅Drink water regularly 💧
✅Take breaks in shaded areas 🌳
✅Wear comfortable clothing 👕
✅Use sun protection (hats or umbrellas) 🧢☂️
🚫Avoid alcohol and caffeine as much as possible 🍺☕

For more details, read full outlook here:
https://www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph/article/210
